During the quarter ended 30 September 2026, the Company allotted 18,00,000 warrants on a preferential basis to the identified allottees, including persons belonging to the Promoter and Promoter Group. The shares underlying the outstanding warrants have been disclosed under the relevant column for outstanding convertible securities, including warrants, in the shareholding pattern. The underlying equity shares shall be reflected as equity shareholding upon conversion and allotment in accordance with the terms of the warrants.

The name of Krippie Soni has been included in Table II of the shareholding pattern for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, following the allotment of warrants to the said allottee and the applicable promoter classification. As the allottee did not hold any equity shares as at the quarter end, the equity shareholding has been reported as NIL, while the shares underlying the outstanding warrants have been disclosed in the relevant column, as applicable.
